name: branding-vintage-bbq-badge-with-script-and-block-type
title: Arched retro banner badge for a BBQ restaurant with slab lettering, script and drop shadow
whatItIs: A white slide with tiny caps labels and a black-and-white badge shaped like an arched banner with a stepped bottom tab. It reads 'SLOW BURN' in slanted slab caps, 'by Kastanienhof' in script and 'BBQ' in a square sans, with an offset shadow.
whatItMeans: Warm and smoky; classic signage cues say old-school barbecue.
techniques: Shape the badge like a vintage sign banner.
Layer slab, script and square sans.

vocabulary.definition: A logo shaped like a signboard.
Heavy serif capitals with square serifs.
Multiple type styles layered in one lockup.
